checkpoints.title: Milestone gate on the dev tip, one fix PR per failed check, gate_fixes in the mission record
contracts: internal/cli/mission.go: gate on the last merge of a milestone; plan.json `milestones[].gate` {state, dev_sha} and `gate_fixes[]` {pr, milestone, check, dev_sha, approval {record, sha256}, at}
no model decides pass or fail: required checks, `aayu verify --check all`, and the touched seats' evals
instrumentation: one gate record per run with each check's result and the dev SHA
inbox card on the third failure
checkpoints.rollback: Revert the squash commit; nothing else to undo.
